common_format.fixture_policy: procedural synthetic graphics or repository assets with a checked-in license; no remote references
common_format.strict_native_status: not certified by the software baseline; must be requested explicitly and must not silently fall back

output_contract.per_case: {id}_{slug}/scene.json, expected.json, output.mp4, frames/frame_000.png, frames/frame_{mid:03}.png, frames/frame_{last:03}.png, metrics.json

criteria.exact_stream: H.264, 1920x1080, 30/1 FPS; duration equals frame_count/30 within one video timebase tick
criteria.visual_minimum: at least 2 distinct decoded frames and extracted frame 0/midpoint/last PNGs; semantic coverage remains an explicitly unverified manual review criterion
criteria.determinism: compare decoded RGB frame SHA-256 hashes across two renders in the same software backend/environment; report equality, never infer cross-backend bit identity
criteria.technical: successful canonical validation/render/encode/decode, finite reported timings, source and result hashes, no generated remote assets
criteria.feature_status: PASS requires every requested feature; PARTIAL means executable video but at least one requested feature is absent; BLOCKED means requested end-to-end path cannot be represented/rendered; FAIL means implementation/check violation

cases.name: Glowing Path Follow
blocked: arc-length tangent orientation is not guaranteed by path-follow plan contract

cases.name: Procedural Light Trails
blocked: continuous per-vertex trail width/falloff is not modeled

cases.name: Particle Vortex
blocked: time-varying vortex force/particle paths and particle depth animation unavailable in render-plan emitter

cases.name: Shape Morphing
implemented: SVG morph exists in Motion authoring
blocked: SVG/path morph does not lower to the canonical Chronon3D RenderPlan renderer

cases.name: Puppet Pin Character
blocked: animated deformed mesh plus source texture/alpha transport is not supported end-to-end by RenderPlan consumer

cases.name: Full Body IK Rig
implemented: Motion FK/IK/FABRIK/constraints and deterministic rig tests
blocked: rig pose animation does not lower to a renderable animated mesh/sprite in Chronon3D

cases.name: Elastic Mesh Deformation
implemented: static UV inline mesh consumer path
blocked: deformed mesh vertex samples are not represented as animated RenderPlan tracks

cases.name: Animated Rotoscope Mask
implemented: CPU mask-segment/propagate CLI tools exist independently
blocked: per-frame alpha mask and tracked video matte cannot currently feed this RenderPlan compositing path as an animated matte

cases.name: Liquid Mask Reveal
implemented: static shape/path, alpha opacity and compositing
blocked: animated mask-path morph/feather clipping is not supported by canonical plan renderer

cases.name: Cinematic Parallax Scene
blocked: the plan does not encode six independently moving depth planes or per-layer camera parallax, so its current output is not functional acceptance for this case

cases.name: Floating Product Orbit
blocked: no asset-backed 3D product models or verified motion-blur integration in this scenario

cases.name: Real 3D Geometry Test
implemented: ChrononMotion procedural geometry and static inline mesh/UV in RenderPlan
blocked: mesh draw path in RenderPlan has no verified materializer-to-pixels parity; animated geometry and glTF mesh import/render integration unavailable

cases.name: Advanced Glitch Transition
blocked: time-varying displacement maps, RGB split and glitch effect stack not represented

cases.name: Cinematic Glow & Light Rays
implemented: software glow and animated 2D light layers
blocked: volumetric rays and verified HDR bloom/light masking are unavailable in canonical software plan path

cases.name: Velocity Motion Blur
implemented: CLI temporal motion blur option exists
blocked: deformable subject and verified per-object shutter/subframe blur acceptance not established

cases.name: Kinetic Typography
implemented: text shaping/font metrics and basic text animation
blocked: per-character cluster-aware motion with mixed character animation is not verified for this consumer contract

cases.name: Documentary Map Flyover
blocked: external map imagery not included; use synthetic map only, and generator output requires canonical validate/render verification

cases.name: Product Explainer Ultimate
implemented: 2.5D cards, paths, text, camera and effects individually
blocked: presenter rig/animated matte integration unavailable

cases.name: Cinematic Documentary Montage
implemented: video layers, still image layers and transition primitives
blocked: checked-in licensed video/matte fixture absent; subject freeze/mask propagation-to-composite path is not demonstrated end-to-end

cases.name: Chronon Master Composition
implemented: 2D/2.5D plans and separate Motion rig/mesh authoring
blocked: animated mesh, mask, morph, and real-3D mesh render paths cannot yet compose in a single canonical RenderPlan
